name: Yam Mosaic Virus
description: A potyvirus causing mosaic patterns and leaf distortion in yam. It is one of the most important viral diseases of yam in West Africa, transmitted by aphids and through infected planting material, causing significant yield reduction.
symptoms: Light green to yellow mosaic patterns on leaves
Leaf distortion and reduced leaf size
Stunted plant growth and poor vine development
Tubers may show cracking and internal necrosis
causes: Use of infected setts for planting
Alternative weed and wild yam hosts serving as reservoirs
treatments: Remove and destroy severely infected plants
Control aphid vectors with neem oil or insecticidal soap
prevention: Plant resistant yam varieties where available
Control aphids in and around yam fields
Remove weed hosts near yam fields
Use insect-proof nets in yam nurseries
